provenance.headline: PARTIALLY SOURCED NBA 2K27 DATA. Badges and thresholds are real; caps, costs and the build budget are not.
explanation: SOURCED (trust, but re-check): every badge requirement and badge token cost for the Shooting,
Playmaking, Defense and Finishing disciplines, taken from NBA 2K27 badge cost charts; the
animation and takeover thresholds named on a community 'best value attribute thresholds' sheet;
the builder's attribute list; and the direction of each body setting's effect on caps.
NOT SOURCED (assume wrong): attribute CAPS (only the direction of each body effect is known,
not the magnitude), the per-point COST CURVES, the total BUILD POINT BUDGET, cap breaker
quantities, badge boost slot counts, and the badge token EARNING formula.
MISSING ENTIRELY: the Rebounding and Physicals badge cost charts. The handful of rebounding and
physicals badges present were reconstructed from single lines on the best-value sheet, carry
only one tier each, and are flagged with incompleteTiers.
Attribute names are 2K27's. Badge names are 2K27's. Archetype names are community convention,
provenance.howToReplace: See docs/DATA.md. Replace values in place and set each record's verification.status with a source. Nothing in the UI or engine hard-codes these numbers.

verificationLevels.verified: Confirmed against the shipped NBA 2K27 builder or an official 2K source. Safe to trust.
verificationLevels.community-verified: Taken from the supplied NBA 2K27 badge charts / community threshold sheets. Trust with care; re-check against the NBA 2K HQ app.
verificationLevels.estimated: Derived or interpolated from partially known data, or read off a degraded source image. Directionally useful, numerically approximate.
verificationLevels.deprecated: Known to be wrong / no longer applies. Retained for history, ignored by the engine.

defaultVerification.notes: No source recorded for this record.

uiWarnings.globalBanner: Badge requirements and token costs are from real NBA 2K27 charts. Attribute CAPS, COST CURVES and the BUILD POINT BUDGET are still placeholders — builds will pick the right thresholds but may be affordable when they should not be. Rebounding and Physicals badge charts are missing entirely.

changes: Replaced all badge data with sourced NBA 2K27 requirements and badge token costs (Shooting, Playmaking, Defense, Finishing).
Removed Stamina: not a 2K27 builder attribute, raised in-game at the Gatorade gym.
Removed Acceleration, added Agility, which is what 2K27 defensive badges actually require.
Split Rebounding out of Defense into its own discipline (2K27 has six badge disciplines).
Dropped the Legend badge tier: 2K27 charts show Bronze/Silver/Gold/Hall of Fame only.
Added badge-tokens.json for the new token + slot economy.
Added support for 'any of' badge requirements, which 2K27 uses heavily.
Corrected the sign of the weight and wingspan effect on Perimeter Defense and Driving Dunk caps.
Rewrote animations and takeovers to only what the best-value threshold sheet names.
Initial scaffold with fully invented placeholder data.
